Erin — congrats again on signing. I’m sharing a compact, operational proposal that embeds the MAP into a runnable rollout plan. High level: 

- Canary cohort: 5% traffic; two-week observation window; automated metric thresholds (error rate, p95 latency, accuracy drift)
- Phased migration: week 1 canary -> week 3 expand to 25% -> week 5 full cutover with a 48-hour fallback window
- Training: two instructor-led console sessions + one joint dry-run in the staging cluster before week 1
- Eval: Redwood will run Aurelia’s 200-prompt eval during canary and generate a regression matrix and examples for any regressions > 3%
- Rollback & safeguards: circuit that flips traffic back to baseline model if thresholds breached; extended monitoring team on-call during cutover windows

I attached a canary-guardrails checklist and an operator runbook draft to get us started. Can Marissa coordinate scheduling the runbook walk and Neha scope the monitoring dashboards?

Next steps (suggested):
1) Confirm SLA guardrail thresholds (error rate/p95/quality window) — Erin by Fri 6/12
2) Finalize training dates — Marissa by Mon 6/14
3) HubSpot deal updated + DocuSign link for ops addendum — PR by EOD 6/15

If that timeline looks OK I’ll put calendar invites and a mutual action plan page in the Drive.

Thanks,

- Runbook: I uploaded operator-runbook-draft.md; it includes step-by-step rollback commands, observability queries (PromQL + tracing spans) and runbook phone numbers for on-call rotations.
